schema.schemaVersion: string — this index format's own version, bumped only if the top-level shape changes
schema.generatedAt: string — ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of this build
schema.sourceRoot: string — relative to AOS/, the directory tree this index was built from
schema.orchestratorConfigPath: string — relative to AOS/, where the employee-level dependency graph used for lineage was read from
schema.employeeCounts: object — employee key -> number of artifacts indexed for that employee (platform artifacts under 'orchestrator'/'daily-briefs' excluded)
schema.validationSummary: object — flaggedCount (artifacts with at least one Phase 3 structural flag, advisory only, never blocking) and flagCounts (flag name -> occurrence count)
schema.artifacts: array of artifact records — see registry_model.py's build_artifact_record() for the exact per-record shape
